# Apify Actor telemetry

> Shared, bounded exception telemetry for Node.js Apify Actors. Package name: actor-telemetry-provisional. Inspect the selected revision's implementation and declarations before integrating.

- [Coding agent guide](docs/agent-guide.md): ownership and critical checks.
